trials.method: Window raised before timed activation; screenshot then AX

classification: Observation-method calibration only; no p95 gate qualified
visibility_check: Raising the window brought pixels into agreement with the already-updated public state; actual OS occlusion/presentation times were unavailable
scope: Measurement-method calibration on one LED reference only; no application latency threshold failure or pass established
repetition_gate: 20 per reference circuit not attempted after the method calibration failed; p95 not calculated
reference_scope_correction: PRD section 11 names LED, RC and NPN switch. The capacitor-timed flasher is an additional stress/reference exercise, not a replacement for the NPN switch performance case.
interpretation: First two trials did not establish a visible foreground precondition; a later Raise made the screenshot agree with already-updated public state. Occlusion is a possible explanation, not an observed OS fact.
Screenshot/observation call duration includes tool waiting/capture/transfer overhead; it is not a native presentation duration.
The raised trial showed the expected new value/sample by return, but its 851 ms bound cannot resolve a 100 ms target or attribute a 500 ms miss to ELab.
Framework FrameMetrics and NativeActivity explicitly exclude actual compositor presentation; their CPU/present-call durations cannot replace this gate.
cold_warm: Warm initialized app/session; cold routing not measured
operator_path: Cua native value field + Apply button in the separate harness; native input timestamp not exposed
approval_state: VoiceOver and caption-panel permission requested; no response/approval recorded, no OS setting change performed
